title: Satisfaction after clearing a pivot
statement:
Let $
u$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a pivot variable, and let $P$ and $R$ be linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$ on $
u$. For any assignment $x\colon
u	o\mathbb{F}_2$ satisfying $P$, the cleared row equation is satisfied by $x$ if and only if $R$ is satisfied by $x$.
